title: xDesign bot spec, format version 1
description: spec.json of an xDesign export: one Telegram bot design, Bot API 10.5.

Ref.description: The ID name of a step, button, variable, switch or part, or the id of a media entry.

IdName.description: An ID name: a letter a to z, then up to 47 of a to z, 0 to 9 and _.

Condition.description: All or any of the items hold.

Target.description: The ID name of the step an arrow goes to, "back" for the message step the user came from, or null for no arrow.

Step.description: A step: a box on the map with its arrows by ID name.

RichText.description: A text of a message, caption or text part per language.

LangRichText.description: One language of a text: plain text with {idName} placeholders, entities, Telegram HTML, the variable places and the rich document.

Entity.description: A MessageEntity; offsets and lengths count UTF-16 code units.

RichDoc.description: A rich text document (TipTap JSON); variable and part nodes hold ID names.

RichBlock.description: A block of a rich message (InputRichBlock): paragraph, footer, heading (size 1 to 6), code (pre), quote, list, table, details, divider, media or a row of buttons.

Button.description: A button with what a press does and its Bot API mapping.

RememberAction.description: Set, clear or change a variable.

Keyboard.description: The keyboard of a message, or null for none.

Options.description: The options of a message: silent is disable_notification, protect is protect_content, then the link preview, the message effect ID, a chat action sent before it, a delay in seconds, and a draft written out first (draft) with its stop button (draftStop is can_stop, draftKeep keep_on_stop).

Invoice.description: What an invoice sells, as sendInvoice takes it: amounts in the smallest unit of the currency.
